description: This file defines the 'Config' class within the 'Opencart.System.Engine' namespace. The class provides methods for managing configuration data, including adding paths, loading configuration files, and setting/getting configuration values.
published: Opencart	extbackslash	extbackslash System	extbackslash	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash	extbackslash Config

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that manages configuration data, including paths and key-value pairs, and loading configuration files.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a directory path associated with a namespace to the configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key from the configuration data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the configuration data.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in the configuration data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a configuration PHP file and merges its array data into the current configuration data.
